limitations: 42 samples in twelve ABBA processes; five warm samples per arm/workload plus fresh samples retained.
Fresh process does not imply cold Windows file cache or cold SSD. Physical memory/SSD bandwidth is not measured.
Absolute rates depend on machine power, temperature and system load; raw power records retained.
Original executable baseline predates the new hybrid environment controls and prints ignored-variable notices; MTP4 and effective CPU/cache/sampler settings are verified from setup/sample records.
This comparison includes the required AUTO attention consistency correction; weights, expert routing, INT8 KV and FP16 recurrent boundaries are unchanged.
Performance promotion requires at least5percent geometric mean, no workload regression above3percent, and no material warm TTFT regression.
Primary warm trials selected lookup only for bounded exploration; apparent aggregate gains cannot be attributed to normal lookup exploitation.
Balanced power scheme on battery; battery declined from56percent to32percent during primary trials. Large long-workload timing variation is retained.
A zero-probe same-binary diagnostic still showed fallback timing/draft-depth differences; no deterministic arithmetic discrepancy was found.
40 tok/s and 50 tok/s are objectives, not achieved acceptance claims from this delivery.

same_binary_probe_zero_diagnostic.purpose: Isolate new MTP4 versus cost hybrid with probes disabled; not a replacement for the frozen-current-profile primary trial
